identity.name: Cinder Nock Rack
identity.summary: A black iron comb holding three ember red arrow nocks.
identity.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 2 burn to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
